title: Caudate
summary: CAUDATE, CAUDATED, CAUDEX, noun In botany, the stem of a tree. Linne uses the word for the stock which proceeds from a seed, one part ascending and forming the body above ground, the other descending

inlines.v: CAUDATE, CAUDATED, CAUDEX, noun In botany, the stem of a tree. Linne uses the word for the stock which proceeds from a seed, one part ascending and forming the body above ground, the other descending and putting forth roots.
